source.title: Efficiency for multitime vector variational problems on Riemannian manifolds involving geodesic quasiinvex functionals

trace.notes: Input preserved original zbMATH URL and supplied a resolved target URL. The resolved target was the arXiv PDF for arXiv:1506.04009, downloaded to the local workflow temp directory for PDF parsing.

Mapped the source as a PDF article on multitime scalar, vector, and vector fractional variational problems, with sections devoted to definitions and necessary or sufficient efficiency and optimality conditions. The visible arXiv record gives the same title and describes the article purpose as establishing necessary and sufficient conditions rather than posing open problems.
Screened introductory and purpose statements for open-problem markers. Statements such as establishing sufficient efficiency conditions describe completed objectives, not unresolved questions.
Screened mathematical problem formulations labeled SVP, VVP, and VFP. These are optimization models studied in the article, not open research questions to be extracted.
No candidate open questions were extracted, so no duplicate clusters were formed.
No accepted or review candidates were emitted. Abstract-only or metadata-only text was not used as technical evidence for any extracted question.
